spans.text: At some point, Dark Warrior N has appeared on top of a statue, wearing a mantle of black flame.

units.rawText: Dark Warrior N, it's you!
units.displayText: Dark Warrior N, it's you!

spans.text: Dark Warrior N, it's you!

units.rawText: Do you see now, S? This is the blackest night of all.
units.displayText: Do you see now, S? This is the blackest night of all.

spans.text: Do you see now, S? This is the blackest night of all.

units.rawText: The statues are under the control of the darkness, and your friend – <cmdr> and their lover are both in danger.

and their lover are both in danger.

units.rawText: ...I can't believe you actually brought them into this! Dark Warrior N, you're despicable!
units.displayText: ...I can't believe you actually brought them into this! Dark Warrior N, you're despicable!

spans.text: ...I can't believe you actually brought them into this! Dark Warrior N, you're despicable!

units.displayText: If you want to fight the darkness, then you must sacrifice something.

units.displayText: Choose, S. Will you protect the audience, or the people you're closest to?

spans.text: Choose, S. Will you protect the audience, or the people you're closest to?

units.rawText: Dammit... I won't abandon anyone!
units.displayText: Dammit... I won't abandon anyone!

spans.text: Dammit... I won't abandon anyone!

units.rawText: Anyone can say pretty words. Now back them up with your actions!
units.displayText: Anyone can say pretty words. Now back them up with your actions!

units.rawText: Mysterious Warrior S can do it!
units.displayText: Mysterious Warrior S can do it!

spans.text: Mysterious Warrior S can do it!

units.rawText: Do your best, Mysterious Warrior S! Beat this trial and make Dark Warrior N fight by your side!
units.displayText: Do your best, Mysterious Warrior S! Beat this trial and make Dark Warrior N fight by your side!

spans.text: Do your best, Mysterious Warrior S! Beat this trial and make Dark Warrior N fight by your side!

units.displayText: Where did this kid come from? Is she an agent from the children's zone?

units.rawText: What are you even talking about, how could N fight alongside S?
units.displayText: What are you even talking about, how could N fight alongside S?

spans.text: What are you even talking about, how could N fight alongside S?

units.rawText: N's a hero of justice too! She saved me once!
units.displayText: N's a hero of justice too! She saved me once!

spans.text: N's a hero of justice too! She saved me once!

units.rawText: I can't do anything... But I can still cheer them on! That's because they told me that I was their friend too!

units.displayText: On the stage, Eos and I look down upon the gathered agents.

units.rawText: What startling energy she has. It's the polar opposite of most agents.
units.displayText: What startling energy she has. It's the polar opposite of most agents.

spans.text: What startling energy she has. It's the polar opposite of most agents.

options.rawText: Indeed, it's much different from most agents in Magrasea.
options.displayText: Indeed, it's much different from most agents in Magrasea.

options.rawText: That's how agents ought to be.
options.displayText: That's how agents ought to be.

options.rawText: Mysterious Warrior Omega hasn't shown up yet. Stay alert.
options.displayText: Mysterious Warrior Omega hasn't shown up yet. Stay alert.

units.rawText: Yet you don't seem too surprised.
units.displayText: Yet you don't seem too surprised.

spans.text: Yet you don't seem too surprised.

units.rawText: And have you already seen an agent like that?
units.displayText: And have you already seen an agent like that?

spans.text: And have you already seen an agent like that?

units.rawText: You can't read the mood at all... Although, perhaps this is the reserve that a leader ought to have?

units.displayText: I look at the place where Persicaria mentioned.

units.displayText: A distorted, dark-colored figure looms silently into view, its cold, dark glare meeting my gaze.

spans.text: A distorted, dark-colored figure looms silently into view, its cold, dark glare meeting my gaze.

units.rawText: Ah... Gargargrahhh...
units.displayText: Ah... Gargargrahhh...

spans.text: Ah... Gargargrahhh...

units.rawText: His brightly-colored armor has been completely eaten away by the darkness, and the writhing tentacles that emerge from his shoulder silently declare: He is no longer a hero protecting the light.
units.displayText: His brightly-colored armor has been completely eaten away by the darkness, and the writhing tentacles that emerge from his shoulder silently declare: He is no longer a hero protecting the light.

spans.text: His brightly-colored armor has been completely eaten away by the darkness, and the writhing tentacles that emerge from his shoulder silently declare: He is no longer a hero protecting the light.

units.rawText: So he DID show up. Miss Meryl, please stick with the plan to protect the audience.
units.displayText: So he DID show up. Miss Meryl, please stick with the plan to protect the audience.

spans.text: So he DID show up. Miss Meryl, please stick with the plan to protect the audience.

units.rawText: Thank you for that unnecessary line. Stage 2's hover program has been activated.
units.displayText: Thank you for that unnecessary line. Stage 2's hover program has been activated.

spans.text: Thank you for that unnecessary line. Stage 2's hover program has been activated.

units.rawText: The area where we are suddenly lurches into the sky. At the same time, monitors and screens appear all around, continuing to depict the scene on the stage.
units.displayText: The area where we are suddenly lurches into the sky. At the same time, monitors and screens appear all around, continuing to depict the scene on the stage.

spans.text: The area where we are suddenly lurches into the sky. At the same time, monitors and screens appear all around, continuing to depict the scene on the stage.

units.rawText: Once we get you into the sky, we won't have to worry about the audience on the ground!
units.displayText: Once we get you into the sky, we won't have to worry about the audience on the ground!

spans.text: Once we get you into the sky, we won't have to worry about the audience on the ground!

units.rawText: Oh, really?
units.displayText: Oh, really?

spans.text: Oh, really?

units.rawText: You're...

units.displayText: Is-isn't that Mysterious Warrior Omega?

units.rawText: That armor is... oh lord, I can't tell...
units.displayText: That armor is... oh lord, I can't tell...

units.displayText: Omega... I didn't think you'd actually go rogue...

units.displayText: Were you never on the side of justice to begin with?!

units.displayText: Even more statues squirm out of the dark fog, the same purplish-black as his armor.

spans.text: Even more statues squirm out of the dark fog, the same purplish-black as his armor.

units.rawText: Okay, what sort of crazy plot twist is this?
units.displayText: Okay, what sort of crazy plot twist is this?

spans.text: Okay, what sort of crazy plot twist is this?

units.rawText: How the hell should I know?! Oh right, before this, it was always the statues which started moving first before Mysterious Warrior Omega arrived...

spans.text: How the hell should I know?! Oh right, before this, it was always the statues which started moving first before Mysterious Warrior Omega arrived...

spans.text: Wait, so we thought he was the main character, but he was actually the final boss after all?!

units.rawText: Groaaar!
units.displayText: Groaaar!

spans.text: Groaaar!

units.displayText: Clad in dark armor, Mysterious Warrior Omega ignores the debate and roars loudly.

units.rawText: The hostages, he's going to–
units.displayText: The hostages, he's going to–

spans.text: The hostages, he's going to–

units.displayText: He lunges at me without hesitation, but a transparent shield blocks his attack.

spans.text: He lunges at me without hesitation, but a transparent shield blocks his attack.

units.displayText: The shield which sparkles like the stars shatters in one shot. Immediately after that, Dark Warrior N descends out of mid-air and stops Omega's offensive.

spans.text: The shield which sparkles like the stars shatters in one shot. Immediately after that, Dark Warrior N descends out of mid-air and stops Omega's offensive.

units.rawText: Stay out of things between me and S.
units.displayText: Stay out of things between me and S.

spans.text: Stay out of things between me and S.

units.rawText: Roar!
units.displayText: Roar!

spans.text: Roar!

units.rawText: ...Looks like you don't intend to negotiate. Well then.
units.displayText: ...Looks like you don't intend to negotiate. Well then.

spans.text: ...Looks like you don't intend to negotiate. Well then.

units.displayText: As she says this, she waves a hand and undoes our bonds.

units.rawText: <size=28>You should leave ASAP now that we've lured the target here. It's too dangerous. </size>
units.displayText: You should leave ASAP now that we've lured the target here. It's too dangerous.

units.rawText: I'll protect them well.
units.displayText: I'll protect them well.

spans.text: I'll protect them well.

units.rawText: I'm counting on you.
units.displayText: I'm counting on you.

spans.text: I'm counting on you.

units.rawText: What's going on? Why did N make a move?
units.displayText: What's going on? Why did N make a move?

units.rawText: I TOLD you, N is a warrior of justice!
units.displayText: I TOLD you, N is a warrior of justice!

spans.text: I TOLD you, N is a warrior of justice!

units.rawText: Didn't they say it would be interactive? Why are we still stuck here? I'm getting antsy just watching!
units.displayText: Didn't they say it would be interactive? Why are we still stuck here? I'm getting antsy just watching!

spans.text: Didn't they say it would be interactive? Why are we still stuck here? I'm getting antsy just watching!

units.rawText: It's not like we can do anything to help either, right? Are they going to have a battle royale afterwards?

spans.text: It's not like we can do anything to help either, right? Are they going to have a battle royale afterwards?

units.rawText: That's even worse. They're Mysterious Warriors, are we going to be Mysterious Watchers or something? This plot development sucks.

spans.text: That's even worse. They're Mysterious Warriors, are we going to be Mysterious Watchers or something? This plot development sucks.

units.rawText: I'm not happy with this either, but what can we do...

spans.text: I'm not happy with this either, but what can we do...

units.rawText: It is like the dark night of the soul, where the darker it is, the more one longs for the light...
units.displayText: It is like the dark night of the soul, where the darker it is, the more one longs for the light...

spans.text: It is like the dark night of the soul, where the darker it is, the more one longs for the light...

units.rawText: It seems these agents are in such a state.
units.displayText: It seems these agents are in such a state.

spans.text: It seems these agents are in such a state.

units.rawText: Miss Meryl's directorial skills are nothing like an ordinary agent's.
units.displayText: Miss Meryl's directorial skills are nothing like an ordinary agent's.

spans.text: Miss Meryl's directorial skills are nothing like an ordinary agent's.

units.rawText: Even an agent can make great waves with sufficient wisdom and authority. An administrator is even more impressive.
units.displayText: Even an agent can make great waves with sufficient wisdom and authority. An administrator is even more impressive.

spans.text: Even an agent can make great waves with sufficient wisdom and authority. An administrator is even more impressive.

units.rawText: However... Even though Sol and Nascita have managed to hold back the statues, it seems they will be hard-pressed to save everyone.
units.displayText: However... Even though Sol and Nascita have managed to hold back the statues, it seems they will be hard-pressed to save everyone.

spans.text: However... Even though Sol and Nascita have managed to hold back the statues, it seems they will be hard-pressed to save everyone.

units.rawText: It looks like our stars simply aren't strong enough, Professor.
units.displayText: It looks like our stars simply aren't strong enough, Professor.

spans.text: It looks like our stars simply aren't strong enough, Professor.

options.rawText: That's because the real stars haven't all made their entrance yet.
options.displayText: That's because the real stars haven't all made their entrance yet.

spans.text: That's because the real stars haven't all made their entrance yet.

options.rawText: Just keep watching until the very end.
options.displayText: Just keep watching until the very end.

units.rawText: By which you mean...
units.displayText: By which you mean...

spans.text: By which you mean...

units.rawText: Very well, it seems you have something else in store.
units.displayText: Very well, it seems you have something else in store.

spans.text: Very well, it seems you have something else in store.

units.rawText: In that case, I shall bear witness to the charm which directs all this theater, until the curtain falls.
units.displayText: In that case, I shall bear witness to the charm which directs all this theater, until the curtain falls.

spans.text: In that case, I shall bear witness to the charm which directs all this theater, until the curtain falls.

units.rawText: Why did you make a move, N? So you haven't completely fallen after all, have you?
units.displayText: Why did you make a move, N? So you haven't completely fallen after all, have you?

spans.text: Why did you make a move, N? So you haven't completely fallen after all, have you?

units.rawText: Let's put my situation aside for now, S. Right now, you need to face Omega.
units.displayText: Let's put my situation aside for now, S. Right now, you need to face Omega.

spans.text: Let's put my situation aside for now, S. Right now, you need to face Omega.

units.displayText: He no longer believes in the light. Right now, you're fighting alone.

units.rawText: Mysterious Warrior S, will you still believe in your justice even now?
units.displayText: Mysterious Warrior S, will you still believe in your justice even now?

spans.text: Mysterious Warrior S, will you still believe in your justice even now?

units.displayText: No matter what kind of situation I face, I will always choose to protect everyone!

units.displayText: Look around you! You can't do anything!

spans.text: Look around you! You can't do anything!

units.rawText: You think that because you underestimate the power of justice!
units.displayText: You think that because you underestimate the power of justice!

spans.text: You think that because you underestimate the power of justice!

units.displayText: Mysterious Warrior S grits her teeth and knocks a statue monster back, but Omega's blade slashes across her helmet. Her mask breaks, and a deep wound appears on Sol's face.

units.rawText: Following Mysterious Warrior Omega's unexpected betrayal, all the statues throughout the Burbank Sector have fallen under his control, and the sector now faces an unprecedented crisis!

units.rawText: No matter how brave Mysterious Warrior S is, she's going to have a hard time fighting this many enemies. That's right, she's in a pinch.
